description: Answers 'what if I move to X' and 'what would I pay in X': the signed-in member's current country against a target one across the income and asset types on their profile, with the headline rate delta for each. Saves nothing. The summary field is the one-line answer. Follow with get_best_move_date, get_exit_rules and get_move_checklist for the timing, the exit charge and the steps.

from_country.description: Override the starting jurisdiction. Defaults to the member's declared tax residency.

target_country.description: Jurisdiction being considered, name or two-letter code.

name: run_scenario
title: Compare a move
